text: Staff from the City Solicitor's Office are attending to provide advice and seek instructions, from the Board, in relation to certain instructions to staff, issued by the Board, at its meeting of March 27, 2018.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Confirmed its actions in closed session in issuing instructions to staff. 2. Requested the City of Toronto's Integrity Commissioner to investigate the allegation that the confidential attachments to Item CC39.10 "Actions Taken To Date Arising from Council's Decision Respecting the Auditor General's Investigation into a Certain Land Transaction", considered by Toronto City Council at its meeting of April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, were leaked to the media. 3. Directed that the Board report further to City Council, if necessary, on any further actions taken in relation to this matter. 4. Directed that the information contained in the Confidential Attachment to the report (May 15, 2018) from the City Solicitor remain confidential in its entirety, as it contains advice which is subject to solicitor-client privilege.
